entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Another door? Damn, this is takin'[n]forever.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Thinking back to how it felt when we[n]first climbed these, I believe we're not[n]even halfway yet.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Well, this is for Futaba-chan! We need to[n]keep at it!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I wonder if we need to use light to open[n]this door too.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: That's a possibility. In any case, let's try[n]proceeding onward.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What's this thing? It looks like some[n]kinda TV screen...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: There must be some trick to it. Why don't[n]we look around?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: This is likely meant to display a painting.[n]Perhaps we should try to complete that[n]picture from earlier.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: We have opened the second door,[n]but the mystery has only intensified.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There's no doubt we're getting closer[n]to the Treasure. Come on, let's keep[n]moving!
